about: remote_cocoa parity for the Chromium Host page view (p01-process.md 1.4, 3.3; tasks 055, 059). The Chromium Host is Chrome's browser process and cmux's ChromiumHostPageView is the remote NSView. Each mojom method maps to ops (cmux -> host: a cmux_shim_* export, a chromium_host_wire.h kind or a planned wire op below), events (host -> cmux: a CMUX_SHIM_* kind, a wire kind or a planned wire event), cmux (what cmux does itself) or not_needed (why). Chrome allows 5 [Sync] calls; cmux allows none: each is answered from state the host pushes ahead. Check: python3 scripts/cmux-next/gen-chromium-host-wire.py --check-view-parity [--list-unmapped].

AX_EMBEDDER_TOKENS.fields: browser, cmux pid, parent (page view) token, window token; sent on first AX access and when the page view changes window

AX_PAGE_TOKEN.fields: browser, host pid, page root element token from cmux_shim_browser_accessibility_token

BACKGROUND_COLOR.fields: browser, 0xAARRGGBB of the page's own background

CURSOR.fields: browser, cursor type, custom PNG as shm fd, hotspot

DICTIONARY_OVERLAY.fields: browser, attributed string, baseline point in page-view coordinates

IME_CANCEL.fields: browser, input seq; the row names the fork's cmux_shim ime export once 170 adds it

IME_COMMIT_TEXT.fields: browser, text, replacement range, input seq

IME_SET_COMPOSITION.fields: browser, text, text spans, replacement range, selection start and end, input seq

LOOKUP_AT_POINT.fields: browser, point in page-view coordinates; the host answers DICTIONARY_OVERLAY

LOOKUP_RANGE.fields: browser, character range; the host answers DICTIONARY_OVERLAY

PINCH.fields: browser, phase, magnification, point, synthetic flag (input ring frame)

POPUP_MENU.fields: token, browser, items, bounds, item font size, right aligned, selected item

SCREEN_INFO.fields: browser, CGDirectDisplayID, backing scale, color space hash, maximumFramesPerSecond, work area

SHARE_PICKER.fields: token, browser, title, text, URL, file paths, anchor rect

TEXT_INPUT_STATE.fields: browser, input type, flags, selection range, selection text with about 100 characters of context, composition range, per-character rects, caret rect

WHEEL_ACK.fields: browser, seq, consumed x, consumed y, overscroll delta and velocity

WIDGET_CONTEXT.fields: widget id, kind (popup, extension popup, side panel, DevTools, PiP), owner browser, bounds, CAContext id

PopupMenuRunner.Hide.cmux: cancels the NSMenu it shows for that token

RenderWidgetHostNSView.InitAsPopup.cmux: shows the popup widget (date/time, datalist) as a CALayerHost in a cmux panel anchored at its rect, input forwarded like a page

RenderWidgetHostNSView.SetParentWebConte.cmux: the parent is always the tab's ChromiumHostPageView in cmux's view tree; the host only names the CAContext

RenderWidgetHostNSView.DisableDisplay.not_needed: cmux never draws page content into the NSView; pixels arrive only through the CALayerHost on the host's CAContext, so there is no NSView content to disable

RenderWidgetHostNSView.MakeFirstResponde.cmux: first responder is cmux's decision; the host lets a page take focus only when cmux marked it embedder-active and never moves cmux's first responder

RenderWidgetHostNSView.SetBounds.cmux: page geometry comes from cmux's layout (GEOMETRY op); popup widget bounds arrive in WIDGET_CONTEXT

RenderWidgetHostNSView.SetCALayerParams.cmux: sets the CALayerHost contextId; resizes join the CA fence (task 052)

RenderWidgetHostNSView.SetBackgroundColo.cmux: fills the page view behind the layer host, also while a resize waits for its frame

RenderWidgetHostNSView.SetVisible.cmux: visibility is cmux's: the page view pushes visible, hidden or occluded with cmux_shim_browser_set_page_visibility; the host never hides cmux's view

RenderWidgetHostNSView.SetTooltipText.cmux: sets the page view's tooltip at the mouse point

RenderWidgetHostNSView.SetTextInputState.cmux: updates the NSTextInputClient state and secure event input for password fields (task 230)

RenderWidgetHostNSView.SetTextSelection.cmux: keeps the selection text and range for attributedSubstring, Look Up and Use Selection for Find

RenderWidgetHostNSView.SetCompositionRan.cmux: keeps the composition range and per-character rects for firstRect and characterIndex

RenderWidgetHostNSView.CancelComposition.cmux: an empty composition range makes the page view discard its marked text

RenderWidgetHostNSView.SetShowingContext.cmux: cmux shows the context menu from data, so it knows the menu is up until it calls context_menu_done

RenderWidgetHostNSView.SetSupportsAutoFi.not_needed: the flag only adds the macOS AutoFill item to Chrome's native NSMenu; cmux builds the context menu from CONTEXT_MENU data and draws autofill and password suggestions itself (task 061)

RenderWidgetHostNSView.DisplayCursor.cmux: sets the NSCursor over the page view

RenderWidgetHostNSView.SetCursorLocked.cmux: pointer lock: NSCursor.hide and CGAssociateMouseAndMouseCursorPosition(false), raw deltas in the input ring; Escape exits

RenderWidgetHostNSView.SetCursorLockedUn.cmux: sends unaccelerated deltas while the lock asks for them

RenderWidgetHostNSView.ShowDictionaryOve.cmux: Look Up shows the definition for the pushed selection text, no round trip
showDefinitionForAttributedString at the baseline point in the page view

RenderWidgetHostNSView.LockKeyboard.cmux: routes reserved keys to the page while held; Ghostty-reserved keys and Escape stay cmux's

RenderWidgetHostNSView.ShowSharingServic.cmux: shows NSSharingServicePicker at the anchor and answers with the share result

RenderWidgetHostNSView.Destroy.cmux: the view ends on BEFORE_CLOSE or on host exit (task 091); cmux's wire has no late-close race to work around

RenderWidgetHostNSView.GestureScrollEven.cmux: swipe navigation and rubber-band decide from the consumed deltas

RenderWidgetHostNSView.DisplayPopupMenu.cmux: shows an NSMenu at the bounds and replies with the chosen index or none; a host exit resolves it (task 091)

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.SyncIsWidgetF.cmux: a page view on CONTEXT is a tab's main-frame widget; a hosted widget's kind comes in WIDGET_CONTEXT, so cmux never asks

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.RequestShutdo.cmux: closing a popup widget's panel ends that widget

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.OnFirstRespon.cmux: first responder plus embedder-active on the ordered stream (task 092)

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.OnWindowIsKey.cmux: a page is embedder-active only while it is first responder in cmux's key window

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.OnBoundsInWin.cmux: sent only when the presented rect changes

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.OnWindowFrame.cmux: GEOMETRY carries the screen origin for popups and screen coordinates

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.OnScreenInfos.cmux: sent on window move, backing change and screen change so begin-frames follow the display that shows the page

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.BeginKeyboard.cmux: each KEY frame names its page and carries ctl_seq; the ordered stream replaces the begin/end bracket

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.EndKeyboardEv.cmux: same as BeginKeyboardEvent: one frame per key event, ordered by seq

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.ForwardKeyboa.cmux: KeyRouter decides first; keys for the page go on the input ring and unhandled ones come back as KEY_UNHANDLED (task 030)

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.RouteOrProces.cmux: moves coalesce behind an unacked one; clicks are never coalesced

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.RouteOrProces.not_needed: macOS has no touch screen; the page view gets trackpad input as wheel, magnify and smart-magnify events, which have their own rows

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.RouteOrProces.cmux: first wheel event of a gesture leaves at once; later ones sum per phase behind an unacked one; the host sends phases with cmux_shim_browser_send_wheel

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.ForwardMouseE.cmux: synthetic moves and exits (mouse leaves the page view, menu closes) use the same frame

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.ForwardWheelE.cmux: synthetic gesture ends use the same frame

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.ImeCancelComp.cmux: the input context discarded the composition

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.LookUpDiction.cmux: force click and Look Up at a point; the host answers with the word
Look Up for a character range

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.SyncGetCharac.cmux: characterIndexForPoint hit-tests the pushed per-character rects; ime_sync_requests stays 0

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.SyncGetFirstR.cmux: firstRectForCharacterRange reads the pushed composition rects and caret rect

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.CopyToFindPbo.cmux: Use Selection for Find writes the pushed selection text to the find pasteboard, no round trip

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.StartSpeaking.cmux: startSpeaking:; the host pushes the speaking state

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.SyncIsSpeakin.cmux: Edit menu validation reads the pushed speaking state

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.GetRenderWidg.cmux: sends its tokens on first AX access; accessibilityChildren returns the remote element once the page token arrives

RenderWidgetHostNSViewHost.SetRemoteAcce.cmux: resent when the page view moves to another window
